# ResourceGroup

`schemas/records/resource-group.json`

A pool that leases reserve from (docs/design/m0/05 "Resource groups"). Rate windows (account_quota) and credit balances (broker_balance) are separate groups: a provider can have one and not the other. A broker balance is counted in usd_micros, and an evidence target has a known capacity of exactly one slot (12, 13); capacity.CheckGroup checks those nested rules.

## Definitions

### CapacityUnit

Every amount is an integer: money in millionths of a US dollar, GPU time in seconds.

Type: one of `requests`, `tokens`, `usd_micros`, `slots`, `gpu_seconds`

### Amount

Type: integer (minimum `0`, maximum `9007199254740991`)
